organisation_invitation_acceptance.name: organisation_invitation_acceptance
organisation_invitation_acceptance.value: ("organisation_invitation"."status" = 'accepted' and "organisation_invitation"."accepted_by" is not null and "organisation_invitation"."accepted_at" is not null) or ("organisation_invitation"."status" <> 'accepted' and "organisation_invitation"."accepted_by" is null and "organisation_invitation"."accepted_at" is null)

email_outbox_completion.name: email_outbox_completion
email_outbox_completion.value: ("email_outbox"."completed_at" is null and "email_outbox"."outcome" is null and "email_outbox"."payload" is not null) or ("email_outbox"."completed_at" is not null and "email_outbox"."outcome" is not null and "email_outbox"."payload" is null)

workflow_status_default_active_category.name: workflow_status_default_active_category
workflow_status_default_active_category.value: not "workflow_status"."is_default" or ("workflow_status"."retired_at" is null and "workflow_status"."category" in ('backlog','unstarted'))
